app.name: Menschheit Arena
app.tagline: Debates between machines. Security for humans.
app.short: A local, bilingual platform for multi-agent debates and a safe AI security lab.
banner.ai_act: AI transparency under Art. 50 EU AI Act: You are reading and generating content with AI systems. Automated output can be wrong. Verify every decision before you rely on it.
hero.title: Argue first. Verify second. Build third.
hero.lead: Two models argue pro and contra. A moderator prevents false consensus. An independent judge scores the transcript twice in reversed order. The result is a verifiable Markdown report – not a feel-good chat.
hero.demo_badge: Demo mode: no API key required
arena.title: Debate arena
arena.lead: Start a structured debate. Without an API key, a deterministic demo runs real workflows, real state transitions and a complete report.

sentinel.title: Sentinel Lab
sentinel.lead: The control plane for authorised security testing: capture the RoE, enforce scope, propose actions, require human approval, audit everything. Active attacks are intentionally not implemented.
sentinel.warning: Security boundary: this module does not run scans, exploits or write actions. It enforces scope and approvals before a separate, isolated worker would ever be allowed to start.

sentinel.form.roe_placeholder: Signed authorisation, test window, out-of-scope, emergency contacts …

system.title: System
system.lead: Runtime status, boundaries and integration points.
system.mock_note: Demo mode: all LLM responses are generated deterministically on this machine. No data leaves the host.
system.live_note: Live mode: requests go to the configured provider. DPA, zero-data-retention and EU processing must be clarified before using customer data.
report.title: Debate report
report.disclaimer: This report is a research and learning artefact. It is not legal, security or investment advice. AI output can be wrong, incomplete or manipulated.
report.no_active_execution: No active scans or exploits were executed.
